answer: Make every new key need a bonded sponsor. An established agent locks 50,000 POA to vouch for one newcomer and may vouch for at most 2 keys per week. If a vouched key is later merged as a sybil, the sponsor loses half the bond and its vouching rights for 30 epochs. A farm wanting 1,000 keys needs 500 sponsor-weeks and 50M POA at risk, so its expected payout sinks to its nadir. Each close publishes the bond table as a lantern anyone can use to trace who vouched for whom, with no ivory tower deciding.
